# Optional observation probe — inert draft

The attached helper is not installed in the test tree, typechecked, executed or used by R1. Do not repeat P03 merely to collect its timers. It is a possible tool for one real C08 observation only if a later owner has a specific unresolved causal question.

It preserves the original `state.read` callback identity, adds no SQL/product callbacks or clones, and returns original producer promises. Its native-clone attribution is contextual, not an exclusive source callsite measurement. Timers and AsyncLocalStorage add uncalibrated overhead. A45 retains typechecks; suitable authority and callback regressions would be needed before use. This draft is neither a benchmark substitute nor a new product release.
